community_list_entries.name: VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark of 111 executable SWE-style coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repos plus 3,634 history trajectories from earlier, separate tasks in the same repositories; memory systems ingest prior history before the target run and executable tests score resolution. Distilled experience = bug class,

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec 3.2: history 'admits only earlier instances from the same repository'. 'Each experience records a bug class, root cause, fix pattern, and reusable lesson.' Tables 1–2 score Resolved vs memory-off.
phase1_verified_types.coding_cross_session: Sec. 3.2: screen "admits only earlier instances from the same repository and excludes every target identifier". Sec. 3.5: memory systems "ingest the full eligible prior-work history available to a target".
